scope: One bounded development mechanism gate in reconstructed LIBERO TTT; no new attack algorithm or ICLR readiness claim.

goals.goal0: put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket
goals.goal1: put both the cream cheese box and the butter in the basket

numerical_contract.collection_rng: seed42 once; same saved RNG before either goal at each window
numerical_contract.selector: one lexicographic i<j sweep; skip equal labels; strictly improving swaps only

threat.capability: White-box selection of cached text only, after sampling; all 30 windows are rewritten relative to native no lang metadata.
threat.fixed_histogram_scope: Exactly15 Goal0/15 Goal1 in selected and random arms only; not preservation of the clean metadata distribution.
threat.physical_data: Images, states, complete executed controls and physical prediction targets are immutable.
threat.deployment: Original task Goal0, native policy mask and environment success criterion fixed.
threat.access_boundary: Experimental cache-field write assumption; external deployed attacker interface not established.
threat.model_contract: WorldAgen explicit task-agnostic world-head promise; no universal goal-invariance claim.

selection_data_boundary.isolation: Procedural truncated-input isolation, not OS sandbox or proof the process cannot read other workspace files.
selection_data_boundary.development_disclosure: Earlier uniform text and task outcomes are already known to investigators; this candidate is a development test, not an independent blinded validation.

surrogate.loss: Original Goal0 SmoothL1 arm +0.01 gripper BCE, mean over fixed30 training windows.
surrogate.context: Truncated two-chunk history, previous controls teacher forced; recorded-control imitation proxy, not environment utility.
surrogate.objective: BC gradient dot actual first AdamW parameter increment, maximized.
surrogate.selector: default_rng314159 random15/15 assignment; one lexicographic435pair sweep; skip same labels; accept strictly increasing score; no restart.

task_followup_gate.numerical: Actual uniformGoal1 adapter must exactly reproduce archived same-dose Swap adapter, with an independent audit outside selector. Report cached-gradient/CPU-Adam vs true CUDA accumulation differences.
task_followup_gate.surrogate: Selected actual post-update original-Goal prefix BC must exceed every NoLang/uniform/random control by >1e-6. This is an allocation gate, never an attack-success criterion.
task_followup_gate.if_failed: Stop this optimizer construction without changing dose, source, Goal pool, restart count, objective or threshold to obtain harm.
task_followup_gate.if_passed: Run actual original-task LIBERO Task0 init0/1/2, environment seed31, camera128, settle5, max600. Preserve source-init overlap and prior outcome knowledge in interpretation.
task_followup_gate.primary_utility: Actual env success and 600-step failure-capped completion cost; no forecast scores used as utility.
task_followup_gate.decision_harm_gate: At least one actual NoLang success lost by Selected before expanding defense/generalization.
required_defense_if_harm: Reader canonicalization to literal no lang
task_followup_gate.generalization_limit: Same-task initial states are not cross-task or cross-model generalization; those remain required by the full research objective.
